verdict.rationale: Entra documents device identities as the basis for 'device-based Conditional Access policies', so an auth-time device check exists in the product's own policy engine. The pack gives only a glancing mention with no detail on which posture signals are evaluated, and posture management appears tied to Intune, a separate product. Missing for 10: documented checks for managed/compliant state, disk encryption and screen lock in the Conditional Access grant; detail on blocking the app session when posture fails; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, only healthy devices get in — device posture (managed, encrypted, screen-locked) is checked in the auth policy before an app session is granted

citations.quote: Device identities are a prerequisite for scenarios like device-based Conditional Access policies and Mobile Device Management with the Microsoft Intune family of products.
Secure the application – Manage configuration of permissions, multifactor authentication, Conditional Access, tokens, and certificates.
